entities.name: Amsel
entities.description: A demon-cursed former Cathar and thief on Innistrad, adopted by Jofridus, who avenges Reika's death.

entities.name: Jofridus
entities.description: Amsel's adoptive father, a church figure secretly a Skirsdag cultist and demon-worshipper.

entities.name: Reika Eberhardt
entities.description: A cathar and friend of Amsel, murdered by Jofridus.

entities.name: Adila Rimheit
entities.description: An Elder with a personal connection to Reika who tasks Amsel with capturing Jofridus.

entities.name: Thatu Reiniger
entities.description: A vampire lord in Stensia killed by Amsel.

entities.name: Geralf Cecani
entities.description: A young necromancer feuding with his sister Gisa.

entities.name: Gisa
entities.description: Geralf Cecani's sister, in a feud with him.

entities.name: Bloodletter
entities.description: A cursed blade Amsel is sent to retrieve and later uses to kill Jofridus.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: Cathedral on Innistrad with a cavern beneath it.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A demon-worshipping cult Jofridus belongs to.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Jofridus sends Amsel to retrieve the Bloodletter; Amsel finds and kills the vampire lord Thatu Reiniger and takes it.
events.quote: He retrieved the cursed blade after finding and killing the vampire lord Thatu Reiniger

events.summary: Amsel and Reika are besieged by undead on the moors and shelter with necromancer Geralf Cecani.
events.quote: They found temporary refuge with a young man named Geralf Cecani

events.summary: Reika accuses Jofridus of being a Skirsdag cultist; Jofridus murders her and tries to recruit Amsel, who flees as a heretic.
events.quote: Jofridus murdered Reika and tried to recruit Amsel into a demonic pact for eternal life.

events.summary: Elder Adila Rimheit commands Amsel to capture Jofridus and expose him to the Lunarch.
events.quote: Rimheit commanded Amsel to capture Jofridus and expose his corruption to the Lunarch

events.summary: Beneath Thraben Cathedral Amsel destroys a demonic manifestation of Reika and kills Jofridus with the Bloodletter.
events.quote: confronted Jofridus and killed him with the cursed blade

events.summary: Near death, Amsel dons the unholy yoke Jofridus had worn, giving up his humanity to survive.
events.quote: Amsel chose to don the unholy yoke that Jofridus had worn, sacrificing his humanity to survive

events.summary: Amsel renounces the name Raben and returns to his original name.
events.quote: returned to his original name, Amsel
